combos.name: Double jab
combos.plain: Two quick jabs with the lead hand, one after the other.
coach_learning: Second jab's the one that lands. Make it count.
Don't pull back between them. Snap, snap.
Step with the second jab. Walk them back.
coach_signature: That double jab runs the fight now.
Nobody gets past that double jab easy.
ring_lands: {name} doubles the jab and backs the partner up.
Two jabs from {name}, both on the nose.
ring_tired: {name} throws the jab once and leaves the second.

combos.name: One-two
combos.plain: A jab with the lead hand, then a straight punch with the back hand.
coach_learning: Jab to find the range, right hand to finish.
Turn the hip on the two. All your weight.
Right hand comes straight back to the chin.
coach_signature: {name}'s one-two is the cleanest in the gym.
That one-two wins rounds on its own.
ring_lands: {name} lands the one-two, clean down the middle.
Jab, right hand. {name} makes it look simple.
ring_tired: {name} jabs, but the right hand never follows.

combos.name: Double jab, right hand
combos.plain: Two jabs to blind, then a straight back-hand punch.
coach_learning: Two jabs to blind, then the right.
Don't telegraph the right. Same rhythm.
Feet under you on the third shot.
coach_signature: Double jab, right hand. {name} could do it asleep.
She owns that rhythm now. Jab, jab, bang.
ring_lands: Two jabs and the right hand from {name}. Lovely.
{name} blinds the partner with the jab and lands the right.
ring_tired: {name} doubles the jab and has nothing behind it.

combos.name: Right hand, left hook
combos.plain: A straight back-hand punch, then a hook with the lead hand.
coach_learning: The right hand sets up the hook. Turn through.
Keep the hook tight. Elbow up.
Pivot on the lead foot for the hook.
coach_signature: Right hand, left hook. {name}'s finisher now.
That hook behind the right catches everyone.
ring_lands: {name} lands the right and the hook comes behind it.
Right hand, left hook. {name} turns heads.
ring_tired: {name} throws the right and the hook drops short.

combos.name: One-two, hook
combos.plain: Jab, straight back hand, then a hook with the lead hand.
coach_learning: One-two to open up, hook to close it.
Hook's short. Don't swing it wide.
Breathe out on every punch. Three breaths.
coach_signature: One-two, hook. Textbook, every time.
{name}'s three-punch combo is the real deal.
ring_lands: {name} goes one-two, hook. All three land.
Jab, right, hook. {name} puts it together.
ring_tired: {name} starts the combination and runs out of gas.

combos.name: One-two, hook, right hand
combos.plain: Jab, right hand, lead hook, and a last right hand.
coach_learning: Four punches, one breath each. Stay balanced.
Last right hand is the money shot.
Don't stand there after. Move off.
coach_signature: Four-punch combo and she's still balanced.
She throws all four and walks out clean.
ring_lands: Four punches from {name}. The judges love that.
{name} empties the combination and steps away.
ring_tired: {name} gets two punches out of four. Tired arms.

combos.name: Hook body, hook head
combos.plain: A hook to the ribs, then the same hand hooks to the head.
coach_learning: Body first. The hands come down. Then upstairs.
Bend the knees for the body hook.
Same hand, twice. Don't reset between.
coach_signature: {name}'s body-head hook is nasty now.
Down then up. They never see the second one.
ring_lands: {name} goes body, then head. Same hand, both land.
Hook to the ribs, hook to the jaw from {name}.
ring_tired: {name} digs the body hook but the head shot isn't there.

combos.name: One-two, hook to the body
combos.plain: Jab, straight right, then a lead hook to the ribs.
coach_learning: One-two up top, then go downstairs.
Drop your level for the body hook. Not your eyes.
Hook under the elbow. Find the gap.
coach_signature: She goes up, up, down better than anyone here.
That body hook at the end is {name}'s trademark.
ring_lands: {name} goes one-two, then rips the body.
Up top twice, then {name} digs to the ribs.
ring_tired: {name} throws the one-two and can't bend for the body.

combos.name: Jab, uppercut, hook
combos.plain: Jab, a rising back-hand uppercut, then a lead hook.
coach_learning: Jab, then the uppercut up the middle.
Dip a touch for the uppercut. Not too much.
Hook comes off the uppercut. Rock and roll.
coach_signature: Jab, uppercut, hook. She does it on the inside now.
Nobody expects the uppercut. She lands it every round.
ring_lands: {name} splits the guard with the uppercut, then hooks.
Jab, uppercut, hook. {name} lands all three.
ring_tired: {name} jabs and the uppercut comes up slow.

combos.name: Slip and counter
combos.plain: Head off the punch, then right hand and hook back.
coach_learning: Slip outside the jab, right hand straight back.
Slip small. Just enough to make it miss.
Counter fast. Before she resets.
coach_signature: She slips and counters like it's nothing.
Jab at {name} and eat the counter.
ring_lands: {name} slips the jab and lands right hand, hook.
Slip, right, hook. {name} makes them pay.
ring_tired: {name} slips it but has nothing to send back.

fresh: {name} is sharp. Plenty left in the tank.
Fresh legs. She can throw everything tonight.
tiring: {name} is breathing hard. Shorter combinations now.
Arms getting heavy. Pick the shots.
empty: {name} is running on empty. Single shots only.
Nothing left. Hold, move, survive the round.
